prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1324; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the facts, if that's alright. I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?
A: It was on a multi-lane road in Conroe, Texas, during the afternoon. I was changing lanes to get over toward an exit.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I checked my mirror, didn't see anybody right beside me, and started moving over. Then I felt a hard scrape on the driver's side and heard the other car's tires.
Q: Did the other vehicle make contact with your car?
A: Yes, it sideswiped me. Their side mirror and the passenger door area hit my door and rear quarter panel.
Q: Did you stop after the collision?
A: I pulled onto the shoulder as soon as I could. I stayed in the car for a minute because my lower back was really tight.
Q: Are you experiencing any injuries?
A: Yes, I have a strain in my lower back. It hurts when I sit too long or bend forward, and I've been taking over-the-counter pain relievers.
Q: Have you seen a doctor or other medical provider for it?
A: I went to urgent care that same day and they gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest and follow up with my regular doctor.
Q: Did you have any pain or stiffness before this accident?
A: I've had some occasional back soreness from lifting at work, but nothing that stopped me from doing my normal routine.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was being careful and signaling before I moved over. I'm willing to provide the medical records you need.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
